notes.title: Exciting News: Two New Chapters Are Coming to Liminalcore!
notes.content:
[h2]We’re thrilled to share that we’re hard at work on two additional chapters for Liminalcore![/h2] These new chapters will not only expand the game but also enhance the overall experience, adding more depth and intrigue to the world you’ve been exploring.

[h2]Here’s what you can expect:[/h2]

[b]Chapter 5:[/b] Scheduled for release in December 2024

[b]Chapter 6:[/b] Following closely in January 2025

Together, these chapters will add an additional 30–45 minutes of gameplay, filled with new challenges, eerie environments, and unsettling discoveries. This expansion will complete our initial vision of Liminalcore.

We’re incredibly grateful for the support and enthusiasm from our amazing community—it’s because of you that we’re able to continue building on this project. We can’t wait to share these new chapters with you and hear your thoughts!

Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the release dates.

Thank you for being a part of the Liminalcore journey!

notes.title: Optimization Patch 01 - Added DLSS 3 & FSR 3
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added DLSS 3 with Frame generation if supported by user's GPU.
[*]Added FSR 3 with Frame generation.
[*]Added Framerate Limit slider.
[*]Fixed collision bugs issues in some areas.
[*]Minor optimization of Chapter 3 ( still not the best optimization ).
[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Switching between upscaling methods may require restart if it doesn't take effect immediately.
[*]Switching from DLSS to FSR crashes the game, while we are investigating this there is a work around for this. [b]Switch from DLSS to TSR then Switch from TSR to FSR[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Liminal Core - Playtest & Feedback Patches
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136111/84a0105a6b26b85c47ca9bd4387cd4c3315ea970.png[/img]

[h1]Hey everyone!
[/h1]
We’re excited to share the progress we’ve made based on the feedback from the playtest sessions on September 26! We had a blast watching you explore the eerie, unsettling spaces of Liminalcore, and your feedback has been invaluable in helping us polish the game. Here’s a breakdown of the updates and fixes that we implemented in the next patch, just a day after the first playtest session:

[h2]Patch Notes:
[/h2][list]
[*] Caustics Added: Enhancing the water visuals to create a more immersive experience.
[*] FOV Slider: Now you can customize your field of view for better control.
[*] Headbobbing Slider: Adjust the intensity to match your comfort level.
[*] VHS Effect Settings: Fine-tune the VHS aesthetic with new options for Fisheye Intensity and VHS Grain Intensity.
[*] Bug Fixes:
[*] Water not loading in certain areas has been fixed.
[*] Resolved strange wave effects near the Dark Zone with a house.
[*] Added controller support for interactions and zooming (Right Trigger for zoom, Left Trigger for interaction).
[*] Fixed the frustrating bug where players would get stuck while sliding.
[*] Corrected footsteps playing tile sounds even when walking in water.
[*] Fixed invisible stairs issue.
[*] Lights no longer disappear at a distance.
[*] Fixed water textures breaking while mounting/dismounting ladders.
[*] Smoothed out the janky ladder end animation.
[*] Splash sounds are now fixed when jumping on tiles.
[*] Resolved a bug where the player would start running unintentionally in “THAT” section.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:
[/h2][list]
[*] Running speed in water has been increased.
[*] Headbobbing has been refined for a smoother experience (no more wobbly camera!).
[/list]

We’re so grateful for your feedback and can’t wait to hear more as we continue improving the game. Your input is key to making Liminalcore the best it can be!

[b]The demo will be live soon, and we’re thrilled to finally share this project with you all. It’s been a challenging but incredibly rewarding journey for our small team, and we couldn’t have done it without your support.[/b]

Thank you for sticking with us through this process. Let’s make Liminalcore the unforgettable liminal experience it’s meant to be!

notes.title: Liminal Core - Devlog 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, This is our first devlog. We will be sharing our progress every week! Stay tuned for more.
Development is going great and we have finished a couple of mechanics that will be seen through out the whole game.

We have finished Level 37 - The Poolrooms and actively working on the remaining levels! Liminalcore will be multiple backroom levels experience.

[h1]New Mechanics[/h1]

[h3]VHS Camera Filter[/h3]
We've added an option in the menu that allows players to toggle the VHS camera filter on or off, giving them the freedom to customize their experience according to their preferences.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYnAzbzk5MWdscmdyc3RwZDh2MGNtMXhheXV4cTQ0cHVyNTRlbnN1bCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/nyZbr5TmF3gnMO6ykV/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Water Interaction System[/h3]
As the game begins at Level 37 - Poolrooms, our primary focus was to create an immersive and realistic water experience.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNHk5anZ4cXk0M3RzMWdnaWZyOHM0cG15ZTdoenhjdzltaWM0eWJhNCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/a8RX7RViheatyHf1Js/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h3]Slide Mechanic[/h3]
And of course, a poolroom experience wouldn’t be complete without slides.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNW01MG5pN3Q3bTBqMXphYjVhcHVmb291cGlwdHUxMGU5NXN1bHRlciZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/STKLoyLqvdbWbBgA5s/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted Stair Collision to act as a ramp to remove camera jitter while walking up
[*]Adjusted Collision of walls and floors to avoid falling through the map at some places.
[*]Adjusted Lumen settings to remove weird flickering.
[*]Fixed Ambience Volumes to better fade between two different ambiences.
[*]Added Footstep Sound based on surface.
[/list]
